source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The client logs free space, requested bytes and folder size when warnIfLocalFileTooBig reports failure. That native helper delegates to the selected store and distinguishes file-too-big from other space failures. The new Too big text therefore adds diagnostic context without proving a full physical disk or repairing the intermittent issue. The caller still catches, logs and requests failed completion. The accepted message retains three concatenated template strings with spaces separating the measurements; that is the checked local message form.
title: The POP3 size log reports measurements without identifying the failed store limit
